source.notes: Biography descriptions are prose ('Chinese calligrapher, active ca. 1023-1056'), so the date must be found inside running text: these entries measure the salvage path. The expected years are ULAN's estStart/estEnd, which are deliberately padded estimates (an active period is widened to plausible lifetime bounds), hence toleranceYears 25. Sixty biographies from each of six bands of estimated start year (before 1400, then by century to 1900 and after).
